structuralScope: Predeclared internal variations of dependency quantities, complementary owners, incompatible equipment, staff qualifications, unavailable capacity and safety. Not externally authored or secret holdout.

execution.isolation: Each world has independent source servers, model budget pool, databases, owners and physical state. Arms within a world run sequentially.
execution.wallTime: Shared-host contention and provider queues can affect actual latency. This pilot compares declared modeled delays, not an industrial real-time throughput claim.

planningTopology: Shared B5/B6/B7 use one incident research coordinator and independently authorized partner execution; isolated arms use one instance. B7 and B6 have identical received sources, tools and owner permissions.
scope: Development pilot, not independent disaster calibration. All scheduled outcomes and failures are retained; no missing outcome is imputed.
costPolicy: Before launching an episode reserve its full fixed cap against the total campaign budget; settle known costs plus unknown-cost reservations. Never shrink a final episode cap.
